assessment.independenceRationale: The homepage and favicon are one official publication, not independent corroborating sources. The official domain and its explicit legal name and site icon together directly support this record and current website use.

variant.basis: The linked 587-square favicon is a standalone fi monogram, not a separate wordmark or slogan. Viewing an independently rasterized reference shows a dark navy f, coral i dot and coral-to-dark vertical gradient on a pale rounded field. It is suitable for assessment as a square-cell symbol; final backing, size and theme legibility require the candidate review.

candidate.detailsJudgement: The original dark navy f and red detached i dot and red-to-dark gradient stem remain visibly intact, with their spacing and proportions preserved. Both Compose Desktop frames reproduce the source emblem and gradient; no clipping or missing detail is visible.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: The complete source emblem bounds are x=172..416 and y=85..503 in the 587-square source. Translating all emblem parts by (-0.5,-0.5) centers those bounds at (293.5,293.5) without scaling. The complete mark fits within the circle with useful clear space; it remains distinct on light and dark Desktop frames.
candidate.rationale: The bank's official original SVG supplies a recognizable standalone fi app mark, suitable for the existing Finsus record's first icon addition. Its light backing is retained because its incidental role is not established; its rounded-square plain field is adapted to the catalog circle.
transforms: Replaced the separable uniform #F0F2F9 rounded-square field with an equal-color circle centered at (293.5,293.5), radius 293.5, transparent outside; this is a catalog adaptation, not a claim of an official circular asset.
Translated the complete source emblem and its gradient together by (-0.5,-0.5) source units; no resizing, cropping, recoloring or separately moving parts.
